acceptance_checks.description: ow_tp_demo.invoices holds exactly 18750 documents, recomputed from Atlas
The sum of embedded line items across all invoices is exactly 149963 (150000 source rows minus 37 orphans)
Order-independent md5 over the migrated invoice-line line format equals manifest checksum 88a66751f0b08b476b492105a2efc537 for the non-orphaned lines
Per-invoice line amount sums and the header total agree exactly at Decimal128 precision; no float arithmetic is used for money
The 37 INVOICE_LINE rows whose INVOICE_ID has no header are quarantined with their source ids and are not attached to any invoice
A second migration run leaves counts, embedded line counts, checksums and the quarantine set byte-identical

planted_anomalies.description: 37 INVOICE_LINE rows reference a non-existent INVOICE_HEADER and must be detected and quarantined, never embedded under a synthesized header

encoding_policy.input_encoding: UTF-8 as read through python-oracledb from the AL32UTF8 database
encoding_policy.byte_transparency: Descriptions and identifiers are carried through unchanged; monetary values are read as Decimal and stored as BSON Decimal128 without rounding
encoding_policy.invalid_bytes: A value that cannot be decoded is quarantined with the raw bytes hex-encoded; it is never replaced by a lossy substitute character

malformed_record_policy.details: A line whose parent header is missing, or whose amount is NULL or unparseable, is quarantined with its anomaly id rather than embedded. A NULL or missing source value may never fail open into a zero amount or a default date.

empty_input_semantics.details: A run that reads zero source rows leaves prior Atlas output untouched and exits non-zero; an empty read at demo scale is a source-connectivity failure.
